name: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream 177ml 6oz Exp 10/2026 For Dry to Very Dry Skin
description:
Our Moisturizing Cream is a rich, non-greasy moisturizer with ceramides that absorbs quickly to help soothe dry, itchy skin on the face and body while helping to restore and maintain the skin's natural protective barrier. Gentle yet effective, this dry skin moisturizer is suitable for the whole family, ages 3 years and up.

Useable for both men and women.

Made For: Normal to Dry Skin

Helps With: Hydration
